title: Customer Dissatisfaction Intake Form
subtitle: “Omnis Questus, Nullus Sanguis” — All Profit, No Blood

style.head: split
style.motto: YOUR CUSTOM IS VALUED · AT MARKET RATE ·

instructions: **Thank you for your feedback.** This form must be completed in full before any complaint regarding the goods or services of the Consolidated Industrial Concern will be acknowledged, reviewed, escalated, or otherwise considered to have happened. Incomplete complaints are not rejected — they are simply filed alongside complete ones, in the same drawer, in no particular order.

fields.text: We are sorry to hear you are dissatisfied. Your dissatisfaction has been recorded in Ledger 7 at its current market value.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.label: Customer name or faction
fields.placeholder: As it appears on your invoice

fields.name: account_no
fields.label: Customer account number
fields.placeholder: If you do not have one, one will be assigned and billed
fields.help: Your account number is printed on your invoice, beneath your other account number.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Preferred correspondence channel
fields.placeholder: Frequency, relay, or carrier pigeon designation

fields.name: tenure
fields.label: How long have you been a customer of the Concern?
options: I was not aware I was a customer

sections.title: Goods or Services Concerned

fields.name: service
fields.label: Which of the Concern’s services are you dissatisfied with? (select all that apply)
options: Contracted security (arranged, but never performed, by the Concern)

fields.name: item
fields.label: Name or designation of the ship, cargo, or goods concerned
fields.placeholder: Hull number, manifest line, or whatever you have been calling it

sections.note: Where more than one service is selected, each is treated as a separate complaint and invoiced accordingly.

sections.title: Nature of Complaint

fields.name: problem
fields.label: The problem is best described as (select all that apply)
options: Delivered early, before we were ready to be disappointed
Delivered to the right place, which turned out to be wrong
Delivered in more pieces than it was sold in
Ship flies, but not in the direction intended
Price exactly as quoted, which somehow felt higher
The Concern also sold one to my competitor

fields.name: dissatisfaction
fields.label: How dissatisfied are you?
options: I am satisfied and am completing this in error

sections.note: Selecting every box is treated as selecting none, per Subsection 12(c)(iv)(iv). Selecting none is not permitted.

sections.title: Statement of Complaint

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Describe the problem in no fewer than 500 words. Testimony is preferred in the third person.
fields.placeholder: Begin with: “On the date in question, the customer…”

fields.name: noticed_on
fields.label: Date the problem was first noticed

fields.name: staff
fields.label: Name of any Concern employee who dealt with you

sections.note: Statements under 500 words will not be rejected, but will be quietly assumed to be a compliment and filed accordingly.

fields.name: remedy
fields.label: Which remedy would you prefer?
options: A voucher towards a future purchase
The satisfaction of having filed this form
fields.help: Refunds are issued as vouchers. Vouchers are issued as forms.

fields.name: collection
fields.label: I confirm the goods are available for collection in their current condition, including any parts that are no longer attached.

fields.name: no_coordinates
fields.label: I confirm that no coordinates have been written on this form.
fields.help: The Concern knows where every customer is and discloses none of them. Collection will be arranged without asking.

fields.name: recommend
fields.label: On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend the Concern to a friend?

fields.name: attachments
fields.label: Documents enclosed with this form (select all that apply)
options: Proof of purchase (the original invoice, not the invoice for the invoice)
Pictures of the goods, before and after the disappointment
Certificate of Dissatisfaction Severity (Form GC-3, which itself requires Form GC-3a)
Declaration of Non-Duplicative Complaint, swearing this complaint is not a duplicate of any Form GC-1 already on file, including this one

fields.name: notary
fields.label: Notary public signature
fields.placeholder: Currently on sabbatical — see Form GC-9 to request alternate notarization

fields.name: acknowledgement
fields.label: I acknowledge that this complaint does not constitute a return, refund, exchange, or admission of fault by the Concern, and may generate further forms.

finePrint: The Consolidated Industrial Concern values your custom. Filing this form does not constitute acceptance, rejection, or acknowledgment of any complaint, fault, or delivery, and may generate further forms. Goods sold are not returnable, except as scrap, at scrap value.
transmittal: **Transmittal:** send this copy to the Consolidated Industrial Concern by the channel through which you made your purchase. Retain a duplicate. The Concern will retain the original, and will not read it.

receipt.message: Thank you. Your complaint has been saved as **{{file}}** and forwarded to the appropriate department or, failing that, another one. Before it can proceed, please complete **Form {{next}}** (attached).
footnotes: Note: Form {{next}} may not appear to relate to your complaint. It supersedes your complaint regardless, and does not resolve it.
